verdict.rationale: Deepgram's multichannel docs state that enabling the option returns separate transcripts for each channel. That directly delivers per-channel transcription, which keeps each side of a stereo call separate. Missing for 10: detail on channel indexing and output structure, confirmation that it works for both pre-recorded and streaming audio, and independent or hands-on corroboration of per-channel accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, stereo or multichannel recordings can be transcribed per channel, so each side of a call stays separate

citations.quote: When set to true, you will receive separate transcripts for each channel.
